verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or data residency for Weave. It only mentions in passing that W&B Multi-tenant, Dedicated Cloud and Self-Managed deployments exist, in an API-base-URL note and a release-policy page. Neither describes selecting where data is stored, so this is adjacent context, not documented residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
